articles.title: Driver fled scene after striking person with car in North York: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say a man was taken to hospital with serious injuries after he was struck by a vehicle that fled the scene in North York on Thursday. articles.title: Former Durham police officer facing additional charges in historic sex assault investigation
articles.summary: The province’s police watchdog has laid additional charges against a former Durham Regional Police Service officer in a decades‑old sexual assault investigation. The Special Investigations Unit (SIU) says Kevin Seamons faces an additional five charges in connection with the alleged sexual assault of another woman between May 1999 and December 2009.
